- memory_id "1000033": The ledger service is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000161" [constraint]: The ledger service must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.  (about: ledger service, Postgres 14)

- memory_id "1000087": The billing API depends on the ledger service for invoice postings.  (about: ledger service, billing API)
- memory_id "1000397": Dashboards and alerts for the indexer are being repointed as part of the 2025-05-20 handover.  (about: indexer)
- memory_id "1000246": The ledger service depends on the authentication gateway for service tokens.  (about: ledger service, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000150": Oskar runs the weekly architecture review.  (about: Oskar, the weekly architecture review)
- memory_id "1000326" [decision]: The catalog service will keep image metadata in a separate table.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000310": The notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000219" [decision]: The notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000363": The authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump, and the Boreal team noticed and pinged the owners.  (about: Boreal team, authentication gateway)
